hero.description: Break through your limits in a fully-equipped 24/7 gym. Whether you want to drop body fat, pack on muscle, or stay active, your journey starts with a free, no-commitment workout.
hero.microCopy: Takes 30 seconds • No payment details needed • Instant WhatsApp booking

about.title: Built for Real Workouts. No Fluff.
about.subtitle: We provide everything you need to reach peak fitness without gimmicks or rigid hour limits.

benefits.title: Open 24 Hours, 7 Days a Week
benefits.desc: Never worry about gym timings again. Early morning cardio or late midnight lifting — your biometric pass lets you workout anytime.

benefits.title: Commercial Heavy Equipment
benefits.desc: Heavy-duty power cages, Olympic barbells, complete dumbbell pairs up to 50kg, and ergonomic cable selectorized machines.

benefits.title: Certified Floor Trainers
benefits.desc: Floor trainers are on deck to correct posture, demonstrate proper form, and prevent injury — without upfront personal training pressure.

benefits.title: High-Energy Group Classes
benefits.desc: Join HIIT, Functional Cardio, Strength Circuits, and Core blast sessions designed to burn fat and build stamina.

benefits.title: Clean & Well-Maintained
benefits.desc: Strict hygiene protocols, sanitized equipment, high-volume air conditioning, and clean locker and shower rooms.

benefits.title: Friendly, Zero-Ego Community
benefits.desc: Whether it is your very first workout or your 500th, you will find supportive members and coaches ready to spot you.

ctaBox.title: Want to try the machines before deciding?
ctaBox.subtitle: Walk in today with a 1-day complimentary guest pass.

classes.title: Trainer-Led Class Sessions
classes.subtitle: Every membership includes access to open gym floor and scheduled classes. Join any session.

items.title: HIIT Fat Burner
items.desc: Fast-paced circuit intervals combining kettlebells, sprints, and bodyweight movements for high calorie burn.

items.title: Power & Hypertrophy
items.desc: Structured barbell & dumbbell lifting targeting major muscle groups for size, strength, and bone density.

items.title: Boxing Conditioning
items.desc: Heavy bag drills, combinations, footwork, and core intervals to build cardiovascular resilience and agility.

items.title: Power Spin / RPM
items.desc: High-cadence stationary cycling simulation with climbing intervals and music-driven sprints.

items.title: Core & Mobility Yoga
items.desc: Deep functional stretching and isometric core holds to improve flexibility, posture, and recovery.

items.title: Functional Circuit
items.desc: Battle ropes, plyo boxes, sled pushes, and medicine ball slams to prepare your body for everyday athletic demands.

schedule.title: Flexible Class Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Open gym floor is accessible 24/7. Classes run throughout the week as scheduled below.
schedule.floorNote: Prefer solo workouts? The main gym floor, free weights, and cardio deck are open 24 hours with uninterrupted access.
